content.title: THE ORGANS YOU NEVER THINK ABOUT ARE SILENTLY RUNNING YOUR {{BODY}}
facts: **BEETS** are good for ARTERIES — the nitrates relax blood vessels so oxygen moves easier through your whole body.
**WALNUTS** are good for the BRAIN — their omega-3s support the fatty sheath around nerves that speeds up thinking.
**PUMPKIN SEEDS** are good for the PROSTATE — 1 oz/day delivers zinc that this gland needs more than almost any other tissue.
**ASPARAGUS** are good for KIDNEYS — it acts as a natural diuretic, helping flush excess sodium and waste.
**TURMERIC** is good for the GALLBLADDER — it stimulates bile flow, which keeps fat digestion running smoothly.
**OATS** are good for the GUT LINING — the beta-glucan fiber feeds the mucus layer that protects your intestines.
**SARDINES** are good for the HEART VALVES — their vitamin D and omega-3s support tissue that keeps blood flowing one direction.
**DARK LEAFY GREENS** are good for the SPLEEN — the iron and folate support healthy red blood cell turnover.
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
A few of these deserve a closer look. Beets work because the nitrates convert into nitric oxide in your body, which widens blood vessels and lowers the effort your heart needs to push blood through — that's why athletes drink beet juice before workouts. Pumpkin seeds matter because the prostate has one of the highest zinc concentrations of any organ in the body, and low zinc levels are repeatedly linked to prostate issues as men age. Asparagus contains a compound called asparagine that directly signals your kidneys to release more fluid, which is why your urine smell changes shortly after eating it — a sign it's actually working. Everyone's body responds a little differently, so pay attention to what yours is telling you.
